resources.name: North County Family Shelter Desk
resources.contact: Call 555-0101 for same-day family shelter screening.
resources.summary: Family-focused shelter placement desk for flood and fire displacement.

resources.name: Emergency Warming and Overnight Shelter Line
resources.summary: After-hours warming and emergency overnight shelter triage.

resources.name: Safe Harbor Confidential Advocacy
resources.contact: Call 555-0199 from a safe phone; chat available through partner hotline.
resources.summary: Confidential domestic violence advocacy, safety planning, and shelter connection.

resources.name: Lakeview Mutual Aid Pantry
resources.contact: Walk-up pantry Tue/Thu/Sat 10am-2pm at 88 Cedar St.
resources.summary: Groceries, diapers, and formula while supplies last.

resources.name: Benefits and SNAP Outreach Team
resources.contact: Call 555-0103 for SNAP screening and emergency food referrals.
resources.summary: Benefits screening and food assistance navigation.

resources.name: Mobile Recovery Clinic
resources.summary: Basic urgent care, wound checks, and medication bridge referrals.

resources.name: Emergency Prescription Bridge Desk
resources.contact: Call 555-0105; bring bottle, label, or clinic contact if available.
resources.summary: Same-day routing for lost critical medicine, insulin, oxygen, and urgent refills.

resources.name: Crisis Support and Stabilization Line
resources.contact: Call or text 988 for immediate crisis support.
resources.summary: Immediate mental health crisis support and local stabilization referral.

resources.name: Housing and Disaster Legal Aid
resources.contact: Call 555-0106 and mention eviction, lockout, FEMA, or benefits deadline.
resources.summary: Eviction defense, disaster-benefits appeals, and tenant legal help.

resources.name: Recovery Ride Voucher Desk
resources.contact: Call 555-0107 with pickup location, destination, and appointment time.
resources.summary: Bus passes, rideshare vouchers, and medical appointment rides.

resources.name: Lost Documents Recovery Clinic
resources.contact: Call 555-0108 for ID, birth certificate, and benefits paperwork help.
resources.summary: Document replacement and benefits application support after disaster loss.

resources.name: Veteran Recovery Outreach Team
resources.contact: Call 555-0109 for veteran shelter, benefits, and VA coordination.
resources.summary: Veteran-specific outreach for shelter, documentation, and benefits.

resources.name: Disability Access and Mobility Line
resources.contact: Call 555-0110 for accessible transport, DME, and medical access support.
resources.summary: Mobility-device, durable medical equipment, and accessible transport support.

resources.name: Youth Drop-In and Shelter Link
resources.contact: Call 555-0111 or visit the youth drop-in before 7pm.
resources.summary: Youth-focused drop-in, food, shower, and shelter connection.

resources.name: Pet-Safe Shelter Coordination
resources.contact: Call 555-0112 for pet-friendly shelter or temporary foster options.
resources.summary: Pet-inclusive shelter coordination and temporary pet foster placement.

resources.name: Emergency Utilities Relief Desk
resources.contact: Call 555-0113 with account number, shutoff date, and medical baseline needs.
resources.summary: Power, water, and heating shutoff prevention after disaster hardship.

resources.name: Emergency Childcare Respite Network
resources.contact: Call 555-0114 for short-term childcare slots during appointments or cleanup.
resources.summary: Short-term childcare help for disaster recovery appointments and cleanup.

resources.name: Mobile Shower and Laundry Unit
resources.contact: Call 555-0115 for this week's shower and laundry stop schedule.
resources.summary: Mobile showers, laundry, hygiene kits, diapers, and clean clothes.
